name: Chevron CDR (CAD Hedged)
summary: Chevron Corporation provides oil and gas energy solutions, supplying crude oil and natural gas and making lubricants, additives, petrochemicals and fuels for transportation. It operates through Upstream and Downstream segments. Upstream covers exploring for, developing and producing crude oil and natural gas, LNG liquefaction and regasification, and crude oil transport through major export pipelines.
